serial: default
One bounded prerequisite plan

span.p:
ready-work: opt-in
Compile once with the effective planner
Bound main lookahead to 32 items and 8 candidates by default

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Reuse supply and workload facts within this decision
Consider research resupply and paid recurring producers
Forecast output is not spendable inventory

span.p:
Optional rocket-goal additions
Paid ore-side successors OR mining outposts
Ownership, flow and reservation guards remain active

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

Connected player and native
factory telemetry available?

With admitted background craft:
plan only independent work permitted by job locks
Otherwise retain a bounded observation wait

Emit factory_wait
Observed effect and finite timeout

Rank feasible sources by useful pickup cost

Name, surface and finite position

Add 4 chunks while current radius is below 32
Missing resource at the bound blocks

span.p:

One mine for wood; at most 50 other raw units
Failure identity binds site and inventory target

span.p:
Resolve native recipe
Reject cycles; at most 512 expansions

with a receipt-tracked craft job

Bound batch by ingredient stack capacity

Target at most 50, within native stack size
Acquire coal, then receipt-bound insert

Physically connect water and steam
Fuel boiler and connect electric poles

Subtract buffered inputs
and the current in-flight craft

Resolve water, powered oil pumpjack,
or recursive fluid production

Multi-fluid output: ensure tanks
and physical output connections

Wait for observed research progress
Ready-work coalesces checks with refill deadlines

Build paid landing pad; collect reachable fish or satellite
Preserve unresolved pad, cargo and launch receipts

Verify destination capacity and exact rocket identity

Produce remaining rocket parts

Return bounded prerequisite candidates
Replan from observed effects

span.p:
Bounded sequential service visits
Default at most 3 already-feasible transfers
Never spend forecast collections

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Final composed frontier
Protect urgent supply and committed capital kit
Optional profitable investment is paid and bounded

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Capital completion requires the same owned unit,
native production counter growth and real output
Deadline or reconciled failures may abandon intent

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Optional furnace output cells
Paid burner inserter and chest
Collect commissioned stock before upstream refill

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Optional iron/copper furnace input routes
Paid drill, bounded belts and inserter
Require current topology and native flow evidence

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Manual fuel-service batching for demanded cells
Combine due deficits for up to 16 small burners
Acquire at most 50 coal; transfer and replan serially

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Current logistics boundary
Outposts cover iron/copper and still need manual hauling
No general coal-distribution or downstream belt planner

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Compile the effective capability-aware frontier
